A year ago today we incorporated. Some numbers, since founders rarely share them.

Revenue: 216,000 euros, of which 140,000 came from two customers. That concentration scares me more than any competitor does. Payroll ate 71 percent. I paid myself 38,000 and my co-founder the same.

What I got wrong: I spent four months on a partnership that produced one customer. What I got right: hiring a support person at month five, against all advice, which is the only reason our renewals held.

Year two goal is boring: get to eight customers over 20,000 euros each.
